symbols.whenToUse:
One logging API across Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and workers, with only the plugins each environment needs.
Production pipelines that batch and upload entries, and must not lose them on exit (`flush()`, `shutdown()`).
Forwarding one logger into another (`extends()`), for example a module logger into an audit logger.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Core capabilities of a logger, also passed to plugins as `core` in `install(core)` (without `use` / `unUse`).

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import ILoggerCore from @migaia/logger, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use ILoggerCore when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when ILoggerCore does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
config: Configuration store of the installed plugins. On a logger it is `ILoggerConfig` (`get(path)`, `update(name, recipe)`); inside a plugin `install(core)` it is a reader of that plugin configuration only (`get()`).
ctx: Frozen context of this logger: `id`, application `options`, default context `path`, `topic`, `createdAt` and `env`.
scheduler: Clock and timers used by `flush()`, `shutdown()` and batch deadlines; the `scheduler` option or `systemScheduler`.
runtimeManager: Host capabilities (stdout, UUID, scheduling, fetch, fs) captured at construction from the `runtimeManager` option or `getLoggerRuntimeManager()`; plugins use the same object.
log: Console-style entry point: builds an entry with this tag and message and dispatches it through pipeline, hooks and sinks. A trailing object stays an argument; it is not turned into `meta`. Never throws for sink failures.
log.tag: Entry tag such as `info` or `audit`; the level() threshold applies only to the five standard levels, while its filters apply to every tag.
log.message: Message text; `%s`, `%d`, `%o` placeholders are left for the console sink.
log.args: Extra values stored in `entry.args` in order.
No value. Shutdown handlers can still enqueue final structured entries; calls are ignored after draining closes dispatch admission.
dispatchRaw: Dispatches an entry with explicit fields (`meta`, `data`, `context`, `error`, `time`) for structured or audit logs.
dispatchRaw.input: Required tag and message, plus optional args (default []), meta (undefined), data ({}), context (constructor context), error (first Error argument projected to name/message/stack/raw, otherwise undefined) and time (current Date). The core assigns id; callers cannot supply it. Metadata/data keys such as orderId and route are application-defined. Containers are copied, nested application values stay shared.
dispatchRaw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing; failures go to `onFailure()`.
raw: Writes text straight to stdout (or `console.log` without `process`), skipping pipeline and sinks; used for streaming output. Ignored once shutdown starts.
raw.text: Text passed unchanged to runtimeManager.write. A host stdout writer can preserve no-newline output; the default console.log fallback without process adds its own newline.
raw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing.
usePipeline: Registers a synchronous stage (entry, next, context?) => void in every pipeline mode. PluginHost lifts it into the selected mode; call next(entry) to continue or omit next to drop the entry.
usePipeline.stage: The stage function; call `next` at most once.
The same logger for chaining; synchronous registration works in all modes. Other stage registration methods follow the mode compatibility matrix.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers an async onion-style stage (mode `async` only): code after `await next(entry)` runs once the downstream finished.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (entry, next) => void`.
The same logger; other modes reject it at type level and at runtime.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator stage (modes `generator` and `async-generator`).
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: Generator (entry, context?), with optional pipeline context as the second argument, never next. Return a payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE after yielding to continue; an implicit undefined return halts.
The same logger, for chaining.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers an async generator stage (mode `async-generator` only); each stage runs to its final value before the next.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: Async generator (entry, context?) with optional context as the second argument. Yield stores a candidate; return payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE to continue. The logger explicitly delegates stage registration to its functional Host.
useSink: Registers an output that receives every entry passing the pipeline. Each sink gets its own shallow copy; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`; a throw goes to `onFailure()` with source `sink`.
useSink.sink: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`.
A function that removes only this registration; calling it again does nothing.
hook: Registers a hook under a name: built-in `before`, `after`, `before:<tag>`, `after:<tag>`, or a name a plugin fires. Hooks receive the live entry and may change it.
hook.name: Hook name.
hook.fn: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`.
An idempotent off callback removing only this registration; registering the same function again creates an independent subscription.
fireHook: Runs every hook registered under `name` with the given entry now.
fireHook.name: Hook name to fire.
fireHook.entry: An entry, usually received in a sink or stage.
Nothing; hook failures go to `onFailure()`.
onFailure: Observes failures of sinks, hooks, pipeline, deferred tasks, flush, forwarding and shutdown. Logging calls never throw them, so register this in production. If the terminal runtime reporter throws, rejects or has a throwing then getter, the existing Utils host exception queue exposes that failure without recursion or changing the business result.
onFailure.fn: `({ source, error }) => void`; see `ILogFailure`.
defer: Runs a task after the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager; `flush()` and `shutdown()` wait for it.
defer.task: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
Nothing; the task is scheduled, not awaited.
onFlush: Registers a callback that empties a buffer on every `flush()`.
onFlush.fn: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
flush: Public flush() takes no argument. It waits for tracked deferred tasks, async sink results, onFlush callbacks, batches and forwarded loggers within a 3000 ms scheduler budget. Concurrent pending calls share one Promise; hitting the deadline reports LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE without aborting underlying work or proving delivery.
Resolves when the known work finished or the budget ran out.
onShutdown: Registers a cleanup handler run at the start of `shutdown()`; it may still write final logs.
onShutdown.fn: `(reason) => void | Promise<void>`; `reason` is the value passed to `shutdown()`.
shutdown: Closes the logger: shutdown handlers and flush share a 3000 ms waiting budget, then Host disposal uses execution budgets separately. Handlers can enqueue final structured logs while raw output is closed. Reentrant and later calls share one terminal Promise; completed shutdown ignores new logs and cannot reopen.
shutdown.reason: Why it closes: `manual` from application code; `signal`, `uncaughtException`, `unhandledRejection` are passed by `process()`.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult` from `@migaia/plugin-host`; `cleanupErrors` lists plugin cleanup failures. A clock failure rejects this same published completion after attempting Host cleanup, retaining primary and cleanup causes. Persistent clock failure can also defeat the Host budget; cleanup or receipt success does not promise remote delivery.
dispose: Same as `shutdown("manual")`.
The disposal result of `shutdown()`.
use: Installs plugins after construction (also async ones), through the same checks as constructor plugins. Each call must use new plugin objects.
use.plugins: Plugin objects created by factories such as `level()` or `http(config)`.
A tuple of plugin handles in input order; `handle.extensions` holds the API the plugin added.
unUse: Uninstalls a plugin by name and releases what it registered (stages, sinks, hooks, flush and shutdown callbacks).
unUse.name: Plugin name, such as `LEVEL_PLUGIN_NAME` (`level`).
Resolves after the plugin is removed.
extends: Forwards every entry, after this logger processed it, through the whole pipeline and sinks of each target (their level filters apply). Self or cyclic forwarding throws `EXTENDS_SELF` / `EXTENDS_CYCLE`.
extends.others: Target loggers created by `new Logger()`.
This logger, for chaining.
unextend: Removes forwarding edges to the given loggers; the targets are not closed.
unextend.others: Loggers previously passed to `extends()`.
`true` when at least one edge was removed.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
One logging API across Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and workers, with only the plugins each environment needs.
Production pipelines that batch and upload entries, and must not lose them on exit (`flush()`, `shutdown()`).
Forwarding one logger into another (`extends()`), for example a module logger into an audit logger.

rows: usePipeline；next 先记录值，当前 stage 返回后才执行下游
useAsyncPipeline；await next(entry) 等待下游，可在之后执行收尾
useGeneratorPipeline；每个 stage 耗尽后取终值
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline；依次 await 耗尽各 stage，中间 yield 不提前交给下游

blocks.text: 同步 stage 可提升到全部 mode，generator stage 还可提升到 async-generator；其他异步/生成器 stage 要求相应模式，不兼容时类型为 never，运行时也拒绝 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH。执行中禁止新增 stage。重复 next 产生 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE，延迟 next 产生 PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE 诊断；不调用 next 即截断条目。模式语义与适配由 middleware-pipeline / Plugin Host 拥有，本包不另造执行器。
应用 config.get 支持 'plugin'、'plugin.key'、'plugin.[index].key'；对象和数组配置递归冻结。config.update(name, recipe) 的 patch 是浅合并，不直接修改旧快照。插件 install(core) 中的 core.config 只有无参 get()，只读取当前插件自身配置，不能通过该门面轮询、更新或读取其他插件。

每次安装重新调用插件工厂，不将同一个有状态插件实例跨 Logger 复用。插件安装期可用 core.onDispose(resource) 登记资源，应用变量没有这一安装能力；卸载会撤销该插件登记的 stage、sink、hook、flush/shutdown 回调与扩展。公开调用方使用 ILoggerCore/ILoggerPluginCore，ILoggerDomainCore 仅用于内部装配；类型推导辅助由发布声明和编辑器提示承载。

blocks.text: 同步 stage 可提升到全部 mode，generator stage 还可提升到 async-generator；其他异步/生成器 stage 要求相应模式，不兼容时类型为 never，运行时也拒绝 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH。执行中禁止新增 stage。重复 next 产生 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE，延迟 next 产生 PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE 诊断；不调用 next 即截断条目。模式语义与适配由 middleware-pipeline / Plugin Host 拥有，本包不另造执行器。
应用 config.get 支持 'plugin'、'plugin.key'、'plugin.[index].key'；对象和数组配置递归冻结。config.update(name, recipe) 的 patch 是浅合并，不直接修改旧快照。插件 install(core) 中的 core.config 只有无参 get()，只读取当前插件自身配置，不能通过该门面轮询、更新或读取其他插件。

每次安装重新调用插件工厂，不将同一个有状态插件实例跨 Logger 复用。插件安装期可用 core.onDispose(resource) 登记资源，应用变量没有这一安装能力；卸载会撤销该插件登记的 stage、sink、hook、flush/shutdown 回调与扩展。公开调用方使用 ILoggerCore/ILoggerPluginCore，ILoggerDomainCore 仅用于内部装配；类型推导辅助由发布声明和编辑器提示承载。

scheduler: Clock and timers used by `flush()`, `shutdown()` and batch deadlines; the `scheduler` option or `systemScheduler`.
runtimeManager: Host capabilities (stdout, UUID, scheduling, fetch, fs) captured at construction from the `runtimeManager` option or `getLoggerRuntimeManager()`; plugins use the same object.
log: Console-style entry point: builds an entry with this tag and message and dispatches it through pipeline, hooks and sinks. A trailing object stays an argument; it is not turned into `meta`. Never throws for sink failures.
log.tag: Entry tag such as `info` or `audit`; the level() threshold applies only to the five standard levels, while its filters apply to every tag.
log.message: Message text; `%s`, `%d`, `%o` placeholders are left for the console sink.
log.args: Extra values stored in `entry.args` in order.
No value. Shutdown handlers can still enqueue final structured entries; calls are ignored after draining closes dispatch admission.
dispatchRaw: Dispatches an entry with explicit fields (`meta`, `data`, `context`, `error`, `time`) for structured or audit logs.
dispatchRaw.input: Required tag and message, plus optional args (default []), meta (undefined), data ({}), context (constructor context), error (first Error argument projected to name/message/stack/raw, otherwise undefined) and time (current Date). dispatchRaw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.

raw: Writes text straight to stdout (or `console.log` without `process`), skipping pipeline and sinks; used for streaming output. Ignored once shutdown starts.
raw.text: Text passed unchanged to runtimeManager.write. A host stdout writer can preserve no-newline output; the default console.log fallback without process adds its own newline.
raw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing.
usePipeline: Registers a synchronous stage (entry, next, context?) => void in every pipeline mode. PluginHost lifts it into the selected mode; call next(entry) to continue or omit next to drop the entry.
usePipeline.stage: The stage function; call `next` at most once.
The same logger for chaining; synchronous registration works in all modes. Other stage registration methods follow the mode compatibility matrix.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers an async onion-style stage (mode `async` only): code after `await next(entry)` runs once the downstream finished.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (entry, next) => void`.
The same logger; other modes reject it at type level and at runtime.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator stage (modes `generator` and `async-generator`).
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: Generator (entry, context?), with optional pipeline context as the second argument, never next. Return a payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE after yielding to continue; an implicit undefined return halts.
The same logger, for chaining.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers an async generator stage (mode `async-generator` only); each stage runs to its final value before the next.

A function that removes only this registration; calling it again does nothing.
hook: Registers a hook under a name: built-in `before`, `after`, `before:<tag>`, `after:<tag>`, or a name a plugin fires. Hooks receive the live entry and may change it.
hook.name: Hook name.
hook.fn: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`.
An idempotent off callback removing only this registration; registering the same function again creates an independent subscription.
fireHook: Runs every hook registered under `name` with the given entry now.
fireHook.name: Hook name to fire.
fireHook.entry: An entry, usually received in a sink or stage.
Nothing; hook failures go to `onFailure()`.
onFailure: Observes failures of sinks, hooks, pipeline, deferred tasks, flush, forwarding and shutdown. Logging calls never throw them, so register this in production. If the terminal runtime reporter throws, rejects or has a throwing then getter, the existing Utils host exception queue exposes that failure without recursion or changing the business result.
onFailure.fn: `({ source, error }) => void`; see `ILogFailure`.
defer: Runs a task after the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager; `flush()` and `shutdown()` wait for it.
defer.task: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
Nothing; the task is scheduled, not awaited.
onFlush: Registers a callback that empties a buffer on every `flush()`.
onFlush.fn: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
flush: Public flush() takes no argument. It waits for tracked deferred tasks, async sink results, onFlush callbacks, batches and forwarded loggers within a 3000 ms scheduler budget. Concurrent pending calls share one Promise; hitting the deadline reports LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE without aborting underlying work or proving delivery.
Resolves when the known work finished or the budget ran out.
onShutdown: Registers a cleanup handler run at the start of `shutdown()`; it may still write final logs.
onShutdown.fn: `(reason) => void | Promise<void>`; `reason` is the value passed to `shutdown()`.
shutdown: Closes the logger: shutdown handlers and flush share a 3000 ms waiting budget, then Host disposal uses execution budgets separately. Handlers can enqueue final structured logs while raw output is closed. Reentrant and later calls share one terminal Promise; completed shutdown ignores new logs and cannot reopen.
shutdown.reason: Why it closes: `manual` from application code; `signal`, `uncaughtException`, `unhandledRejection` are passed by `process()`.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult` from `@migaia/plugin-host`; `cleanupErrors` lists plugin cleanup failures. A clock failure rejects this same published completion after attempting Host cleanup, retaining primary and cleanup causes. Persistent clock failure can also defeat the Host budget; cleanup or receipt success does not promise remote delivery.
dispose: Same as `shutdown("manual")`.
The disposal result of `shutdown()`.
extends: Forwards every entry, after this logger processed it, through the whole pipeline and sinks of each target (their level filters apply). Self or cyclic forwarding throws `EXTENDS_SELF` / `EXTENDS_CYCLE`.
extends.others: Target loggers created by `new Logger()`.
This logger, for chaining.
unextend: Removes forwarding edges to the given loggers; the targets are not closed.
unextend.others: Loggers previously passed to `extends()`.
`true` when at least one edge was removed.
onDispose: Inside a plugin `install(core)` only: registers a cleanup run when the plugin is uninstalled.
onDispose.resource: A disposer function or an object with `dispose()`.
Nothing; the cleanup is registered.

members.name: reportFailure
members.description: Reports durable observer and resource failures through the original logger policy.

members.name: config
members.description: Plugins read their own configuration through `core.config.get<TConfig>()`, not `this.config`. This scoped reader exposes the host-owned snapshot without a plugin-name argument. Keeping reads at the core boundary makes plugin configuration available to host diagnostics.

members.name: ctx
members.description: Read-only context containers. See `ILoggerContext` for the mutability boundary.

members.name: scheduler
members.description: The logger's monotonic clock source. `flush`, `shutdown`, batch deadlines, and `boundedWait` use this scheduler. Defaults to utils/scheduler `systemScheduler`. Plugins use it to share the host's clock domain.

members.name: runtimeManager
members.description: Host capabilities captured by this logger; plugins share the same instance owner.

members.name: log
members.signature: log(tag: string, message: string, ...args: unknown[]): void;
members.description: Synchronously constructs and dispatches an entry. Use `dispatchRaw` scheduling options for asynchronous output.

members.name: dispatchRaw
members.description: Dispatches explicit entry fields such as `meta`, `data`, and `context`.

members.name: usePipeline
members.description: Registers a pipeline stage that can transform an entry, forward it with `next`, or drop it by omitting `next`. Supported methods follow the middleware-pipeline promotion table. Sync stages run in any mode. Generator stages also promote to `async-generator`. Other stages require their matching mode. An unresolved mode union retains all methods and leaves validation to runtime admission.

members.description: Register an async stage only when the selected runner admits it; invalid promotion fails.

members.signature: useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: [TMode] extends ['async-generator'] ? (stage: IAsyncGeneratorMiddlewareStage<ILogEntry>) => ILoggerCore<TMode> : [TMode] extends ['sync'] | ['async'] | ['generator'] ? never : (stage: IAsyncGeneratorMiddlewareStage<ILogEntry>) => ILoggerCore<TMode>;
members.description: Register an async-generator stage only for its matching runner.

members.name: useSink
members.description: Registers a sink. Every registered sink processes entries that pass the full pipeline, such as console and HTTP sinks together.

members.name: hook
members.description: Registers a named lifecycle hook. Built-in names are `before`, `after`, `before:${tag}`, and `after:${tag}`. Plugins can also define their own hook names.

members.name: fireHook
members.description: Invoke named hooks using live subscription semantics; returned work is tracked and errors reported.

members.name: onFailure
members.description: Observes asynchronous output failures without changing normal log-call control flow.

members.name: defer
members.description: Schedules work outside the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager. `flush` and `shutdown` wait for this work. Plugins configured for async output use this path for rendering, stdout writes, or network requests.

members.name: onFlush
members.description: Registers a callback to empty a buffer during `flush()`. The core invokes these callbacks and also waits for unfinished `defer()` tasks and Promises returned by sinks. For example, an HTTP sink without batching still keeps each pending request in the drain wait.

members.name: flush
members.description: Drain tracked work, flushers and forwarding targets with a fresh 3000 ms scheduler budget. Concurrent calls share the in-flight Promise; a later completed-cycle call starts a new one. Deadlines and output failures are reported without proving delivery or aborting underlying work. A closed Logger resolves immediately; scheduler/drain failures can still reject.

members.name: onShutdown
members.description: Shutdown disposes installed plugins after draining; subsequent log calls are ignored.

members.name: shutdown
members.description: Publish one stable terminal Promise, run every shutdown handler, flush, then dispose the Host. Handlers and draining share a 3000 ms budget; Host disposal has its separate execution policy. Results expose cleanup errors, while a failed drain/disposal boundary can reject. Completion stays terminal, and all repeated shutdown/dispose calls return that same Promise.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Returns the same terminal completion as shutdown(manual).

members.name: raw
members.description: Writes raw text to stdout without passing through the pipeline or sinks. `asyncOutput: true` schedules the write through `defer`. Streaming plugins such as reasoning use this for token output without a complete log format per token.

members.name: extends
members.signature: extends(...others: readonly Omit<ILoggerCore<TMode, TShared>, 'config' | 'onDispose'>[]): ILoggerCore<TMode, TShared>;
members.description: Forwards entries to the full pipelines and sinks of each target after the current logger processes them. After `log1.extends(log2, log3)`, target level thresholds and filters still apply to forwarded entries. Each forwarding hop records its topic in internal forwarding state carried in `entry.data`. Registration detects cycles using logger context IDs. Runtime forwarding also skips IDs already present in the internal forwarding path. This composes forwarding behavior, not plugin extension types. The returned logger keeps the current logger's TypeScript capabilities; target-only methods are not added.

members.name: unextend
members.description: Removes named extension edges; returns true when at least one edge was removed.

blocks.text: 同步 stage 可提升到全部 mode，generator stage 还可提升到 async-generator；其他异步/生成器 stage 要求相应模式，不兼容时类型为 never，运行时也拒绝 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH。执行中禁止新增 stage。重复 next 产生 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE，延迟 next 产生 PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE 诊断；不调用 next 即截断条目。模式语义与适配由 middleware-pipeline / Plugin Host 拥有，本包不另造执行器。
应用 config.get 支持 'plugin'、'plugin.key'、'plugin.[index].key'；对象和数组配置递归冻结。config.update(name, recipe) 的 patch 是浅合并，不直接修改旧快照。插件 install(core) 中的 core.config 只有无参 get()，只读取当前插件自身配置，不能通过该门面轮询、更新或读取其他插件。

每次安装重新调用插件工厂，不将同一个有状态插件实例跨 Logger 复用。插件安装期可用 core.onDispose(resource) 登记资源，应用变量没有这一安装能力；卸载会撤销该插件登记的 stage、sink、hook、flush/shutdown 回调与扩展。公开调用方使用 ILoggerCore/ILoggerPluginCore，ILoggerDomainCore 仅用于内部装配；类型推导辅助由发布声明和编辑器提示承载。

symbols.name: Logger
symbols.signature: export declare const Logger: IStaticLoggerCtor;
symbols.purpose: Creates a logger with no built-in sink or level methods. Constructor plugins install synchronously in Feature dependency order; a Promise-returning install rejects construction, so install asynchronous plugins later with use(). Static plugin extensions appear on the returned instance with their types.
symbols.core:
options: Construction options; see `ILoggerOptions` (`execution` is required).
A logger instance; invalid options throw `INVALID_OPTION`, a failing plugin rolls back the plugins installed before it and rethrows.
config: Configuration store of the installed plugins. On a logger it is `ILoggerConfig` (`get(path)`, `update(name, recipe)`); inside a plugin `install(core)` it is a reader of that plugin configuration only (`get()`).
ctx: Frozen context of this logger: `id`, application `options`, default context `path`, `topic`, `createdAt` and `env`.
scheduler: Clock and timers used by `flush()`, `shutdown()` and batch deadlines; the `scheduler` option or `systemScheduler`.
runtimeManager: Host capabilities (stdout, UUID, scheduling, fetch, fs) captured at construction from the `runtimeManager` option or `getLoggerRuntimeManager()`; plugins use the same object.
log: Console-style entry point: builds an entry with this tag and message and dispatches it through pipeline, hooks and sinks. A trailing object stays an argument; it is not turned into `meta`. Never throws for sink failures.
log.tag: Entry tag such as `info` or `audit`; the level() threshold applies only to the five standard levels, while its filters apply to every tag.
log.message: Message text; `%s`, `%d`, `%o` placeholders are left for the console sink.
log.args: Extra values stored in `entry.args` in order.
No value. Shutdown handlers can still enqueue final structured entries; calls are ignored after draining closes dispatch admission.
dispatchRaw: Dispatches an entry with explicit fields (`meta`, `data`, `context`, `error`, `time`) for structured or audit logs.
dispatchRaw.input: Required tag and message, plus optional args (default []), meta (undefined), data ({}), context (constructor context), error (first Error argument projected to name/message/stack/raw, otherwise undefined) and time (current Date). The core assigns id; callers cannot supply it. Metadata/data keys such as orderId and route are application-defined. Containers are copied, nested application values stay shared.
dispatchRaw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing; failures go to `onFailure()`.
raw: Writes text straight to stdout (or `console.log` without `process`), skipping pipeline and sinks; used for streaming output. Ignored once shutdown starts.
raw.text: Text passed unchanged to runtimeManager.write. A host stdout writer can preserve no-newline output; the default console.log fallback without process adds its own newline.
raw.options: Optional `{ asyncOutput }`: `true` schedules the output with `defer()` so the call returns before any sink runs; default `false`.
Nothing.
usePipeline: Registers a synchronous stage (entry, next, context?) => void in every pipeline mode. PluginHost lifts it into the selected mode; call next(entry) to continue or omit next to drop the entry.
usePipeline.stage: The stage function; call `next` at most once.
The same logger for chaining; synchronous registration works in all modes. Other stage registration methods follow the mode compatibility matrix.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers an async onion-style stage (mode `async` only): code after `await next(entry)` runs once the downstream finished.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (entry, next) => void`.
The same logger; other modes reject it at type level and at runtime.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator stage (modes `generator` and `async-generator`).
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: Generator (entry, context?), with optional pipeline context as the second argument, never next. Return a payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE after yielding to continue; an implicit undefined return halts.
The same logger, for chaining.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers an async generator stage (mode `async-generator` only); each stage runs to its final value before the next.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: Async generator (entry, context?) with optional context as the second argument. Yield stores a candidate; return payload or GENERATOR_CONTINUE to continue. The logger explicitly delegates stage registration to its functional Host.
useSink: Registers an output that receives every entry passing the pipeline. Each sink gets its own shallow copy; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`; a throw goes to `onFailure()` with source `sink`.
useSink.sink: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`.
A function that removes only this registration; calling it again does nothing.
hook: Registers a hook under a name: built-in `before`, `after`, `before:<tag>`, `after:<tag>`, or a name a plugin fires. Hooks receive the live entry and may change it.
hook.name: Hook name.
hook.fn: `(entry) => void | Promise<void>`; a returned Promise is awaited by `flush()`.
An idempotent off callback removing only this registration; registering the same function again creates an independent subscription.
fireHook: Runs every hook registered under `name` with the given entry now.
fireHook.name: Hook name to fire.
fireHook.entry: An entry, usually received in a sink or stage.
Nothing; hook failures go to `onFailure()`.
onFailure: Observes failures of sinks, hooks, pipeline, deferred tasks, flush, forwarding and shutdown. Logging calls never throw them, so register this in production. If the terminal runtime reporter throws, rejects or has a throwing then getter, the existing Utils host exception queue exposes that failure without recursion or changing the business result.
onFailure.fn: `({ source, error }) => void`; see `ILogFailure`.
defer: Runs a task after the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager; `flush()` and `shutdown()` wait for it.
defer.task: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
Nothing; the task is scheduled, not awaited.
onFlush: Registers a callback that empties a buffer on every `flush()`.
onFlush.fn: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
flush: Public flush() takes no argument. It waits for tracked deferred tasks, async sink results, onFlush callbacks, batches and forwarded loggers within a 3000 ms scheduler budget. Concurrent pending calls share one Promise; hitting the deadline reports LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE without aborting underlying work or proving delivery.
Resolves when the known work finished or the budget ran out.
onShutdown: Registers a cleanup handler run at the start of `shutdown()`; it may still write final logs.
onShutdown.fn: `(reason) => void | Promise<void>`; `reason` is the value passed to `shutdown()`.
shutdown: Closes the logger: shutdown handlers and flush share a 3000 ms waiting budget, then Host disposal uses execution budgets separately. Handlers can enqueue final structured logs while raw output is closed. Reentrant and later calls share one terminal Promise; completed shutdown ignores new logs and cannot reopen.
shutdown.reason: Why it closes: `manual` from application code; `signal`, `uncaughtException`, `unhandledRejection` are passed by `process()`.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult` from `@migaia/plugin-host`; `cleanupErrors` lists plugin cleanup failures. A clock failure rejects this same published completion after attempting Host cleanup, retaining primary and cleanup causes. Persistent clock failure can also defeat the Host budget; cleanup or receipt success does not promise remote delivery.
dispose: Same as `shutdown("manual")`.
The disposal result of `shutdown()`.
use: Installs plugins after construction (also async ones), through the same checks as constructor plugins. Each call must use new plugin objects.
use.plugins: Plugin objects created by factories such as `level()` or `http(config)`.
A tuple of plugin handles in input order; `handle.extensions` holds the API the plugin added.
unUse: Uninstalls a plugin by name and releases what it registered (stages, sinks, hooks, flush and shutdown callbacks).
unUse.name: Plugin name, such as `LEVEL_PLUGIN_NAME` (`level`).
Resolves after the plugin is removed.
extends: Forwards every entry, after this logger processed it, through the whole pipeline and sinks of each target (their level filters apply). Self or cyclic forwarding throws `EXTENDS_SELF` / `EXTENDS_CYCLE`.
extends.others: Target loggers created by `new Logger()`.
This logger, for chaining.
unextend: Removes forwarding edges to the given loggers; the targets are not closed.
unextend.others: Loggers previously passed to `extends()`.
`true` when at least one edge was removed.
onDispose: Inside a plugin `install(core)` only: registers a cleanup run when the plugin is uninstalled.
onDispose.resource: A disposer function or an object with `dispose()`.
Nothing; the cleanup is registered.
execution: Required object containing mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs. Each field is a finite nonnegative millisecond number or false; neither has a default. These Host budgets are distinct from the logger 3000 ms flush/shutdown-handler waiting budget.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Required plugin install/uninstall mutation budget in finite nonnegative milliseconds; false explicitly disables its deadline.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Required Host pipeline drain budget in finite nonnegative milliseconds; false explicitly disables its deadline.
runtimeManager: Host capabilities this logger uses (stdout, UUID, scheduling, fetch, fs).
The manager returned by `getLoggerRuntimeManager()` at construction.
context: Default context path of entries that do not pass `context`.
`[]`: no context.
topic: Name of this logger in the forwarding chain shown by `extends()`.
`""`: not shown.
on: Hooks registered at construction, same as calling `hook(name, fn)` for each key.
`{}`: no hooks.
plugins: Plugins installed synchronously in Feature dependency order within this batch; their static extensions appear on the instance.
`[]`: a bare core with `log()` only.
options: Application settings frozen and exposed to plugins as `core.ctx.options`.
`{}`.
pipeline: Pipeline settings; `mode` is fixed at construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
pipeline.mode: How pipeline stages run; it decides which `use*Pipeline` method is accepted.
`sync`.
Stages run one after another synchronously; register with `usePipeline`.
Onion model: `await next()` waits for the downstream; register with `useAsyncPipeline`.
Generator stages; register with `useGeneratorPipeline`.
Async generator stages, each awaited to its final value; register with `useAsyncGeneratorPipeline`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for flush, shutdown and batch deadlines; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
symbols.advanced:
One logging API across Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and workers, with only the plugins each environment needs.
Production pipelines that batch and upload entries, and must not lose them on exit (`flush()`, `shutdown()`).
Forwarding one logger into another (`extends()`), for example a module logger into an audit logger.
Sharing one plugin object between loggers: create a new one per logger (`level()` twice), otherwise their state is mixed.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples:
import { Logger, LoggerLevel } from '@migaia/logger'
import { level } from '@migaia/logger/plugins'

const log = new Logger({
  execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false },
  plugins: [level({ level: LoggerLevel.warn })]
})
const entries: string[] = []
log.useSink((entry) => {
  entries.push(entry.tag + ':' + entry.message)
})
const off = log.addFilter((entry) => entry.message !== '保密')
log.info('低于阈值')
log.warn('保密')
log.error('可见')
off()
off()
log.warn('保密')
log.setLevel(LoggerLevel.info)
log.info('已放行')
console.log(entries.join(','))
await log.shutdown('manual')

defer: Runs a task after the current synchronous stack through the runtime manager; `flush()` and `shutdown()` wait for it.
defer.task: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
Nothing; the task is scheduled, not awaited.
onFlush: Registers a callback that empties a buffer on every `flush()`.
onFlush.fn: `() => void | Promise<void>`.
flush: Public flush() takes no argument. It waits for tracked deferred tasks, async sink results, onFlush callbacks, batches and forwarded loggers within a 3000 ms scheduler budget. Concurrent pending calls share one Promise; hitting the deadline reports LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE without aborting underlying work or proving delivery.
Resolves when the known work finished or the budget ran out.
onShutdown: Registers a cleanup handler run at the start of `shutdown()`; it may still write final logs.
onShutdown.fn: `(reason) => void | Promise<void>`; `reason` is the value passed to `shutdown()`.
shutdown: Closes the logger: shutdown handlers and flush share a 3000 ms waiting budget, then Host disposal uses execution budgets separately. Handlers can enqueue final structured logs while raw output is closed. Reentrant and later calls share one terminal Promise; completed shutdown ignores new logs and cannot reopen.
shutdown.reason: Why it closes: `manual` from application code; `signal`, `uncaughtException`, `unhandledRejection` are passed by `process()`.
An `IPluginHostDisposalResult` from `@migaia/plugin-host`; `cleanupErrors` lists plugin cleanup failures. A clock failure rejects this same published completion after attempting Host cleanup, retaining primary and cleanup causes. Persistent clock failure can also defeat the Host budget; cleanup or receipt success does not promise remote delivery.
dispose: Same as `shutdown("manual")`.
The disposal result of `shutdown()`.
use: Installs plugins after construction (also async ones), through the same checks as constructor plugins. Each call must use new plugin objects.
use.plugins: Plugin objects created by factories such as `level()` or `http(config)`.
A tuple of plugin handles in input order; `handle.extensions` holds the API the plugin added.
unUse: Uninstalls a plugin by name and releases what it registered (stages, sinks, hooks, flush and shutdown callbacks).
unUse.name: Plugin name, such as `LEVEL_PLUGIN_NAME` (`level`).
Resolves after the plugin is removed.
extends: Forwards every entry, after this logger processed it, through the whole pipeline and sinks of each target (their level filters apply). Self or cyclic forwarding throws `EXTENDS_SELF` / `EXTENDS_CYCLE`.
extends.others: Target loggers created by `new Logger()`.
This logger, for chaining.
unextend: Removes forwarding edges to the given loggers; the targets are not closed.
unextend.others: Loggers previously passed to `extends()`.
`true` when at least one edge was removed.
onDispose: Inside a plugin `install(core)` only: registers a cleanup run when the plugin is uninstalled.
onDispose.resource: A disposer function or an object with `dispose()`.
Nothing; the cleanup is registered.
execution: Required object containing mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs. Each field is a finite nonnegative millisecond number or false; neither has a default. These Host budgets are distinct from the logger 3000 ms flush/shutdown-handler waiting budget.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Required plugin install/uninstall mutation budget in finite nonnegative milliseconds; false explicitly disables its deadline.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Required Host pipeline drain budget in finite nonnegative milliseconds; false explicitly disables its deadline.
runtimeManager: Host capabilities this logger uses (stdout, UUID, scheduling, fetch, fs).
The manager returned by `getLoggerRuntimeManager()` at construction.
context: Default context path of entries that do not pass `context`.
`[]`: no context.
topic: Name of this logger in the forwarding chain shown by `extends()`.
`""`: not shown.
on: Hooks registered at construction, same as calling `hook(name, fn)` for each key.
`{}`: no hooks.
plugins: Plugins installed synchronously in Feature dependency order within this batch; their static extensions appear on the instance.
`[]`: a bare core with `log()` only.
options: Application settings frozen and exposed to plugins as `core.ctx.options`.
`{}`.
pipeline: Pipeline settings; `mode` is fixed at construction.
`{ mode: "sync" }`.
pipeline.mode: How pipeline stages run; it decides which `use*Pipeline` method is accepted.
`sync`.
Stages run one after another synchronously; register with `usePipeline`.
Onion model: `await next()` waits for the downstream; register with `useAsyncPipeline`.
Generator stages; register with `useGeneratorPipeline`.
Async generator stages, each awaited to its final value; register with `useAsyncGeneratorPipeline`.
scheduler: Clock and timers for flush, shutdown and batch deadlines; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
One logging API across Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and workers, with only the plugins each environment needs.
Production pipelines that batch and upload entries, and must not lose them on exit (`flush()`, `shutdown()`).
Forwarding one logger into another (`extends()`), for example a module logger into an audit logger.
Sharing one plugin object between loggers: create a new one per logger (`level()` twice), otherwise their state is mixed.

rows: usePipeline；next 先记录值，当前 stage 返回后才执行下游
useAsyncPipeline；await next(entry) 等待下游，可在之后执行收尾
useGeneratorPipeline；每个 stage 耗尽后取终值
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline；依次 await 耗尽各 stage，中间 yield 不提前交给下游

blocks.text: 同步 stage 可提升到全部 mode，generator stage 还可提升到 async-generator；其他异步/生成器 stage 要求相应模式，不兼容时类型为 never，运行时也拒绝 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH。执行中禁止新增 stage。重复 next 产生 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE，延迟 next 产生 PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE 诊断；不调用 next 即截断条目。模式语义与适配由 middleware-pipeline / Plugin Host 拥有，本包不另造执行器。
应用 config.get 支持 'plugin'、'plugin.key'、'plugin.[index].key'；对象和数组配置递归冻结。config.update(name, recipe) 的 patch 是浅合并，不直接修改旧快照。插件 install(core) 中的 core.config 只有无参 get()，只读取当前插件自身配置，不能通过该门面轮询、更新或读取其他插件。

每次安装重新调用插件工厂，不将同一个有状态插件实例跨 Logger 复用。插件安装期可用 core.onDispose(resource) 登记资源，应用变量没有这一安装能力；卸载会撤销该插件登记的 stage、sink、hook、flush/shutdown 回调与扩展。公开调用方使用 ILoggerCore/ILoggerPluginCore，ILoggerDomainCore 仅用于内部装配；类型推导辅助由发布声明和编辑器提示承载。
Logger 自有错误 source 为 @migaia/logger；来自 Plugin Host、middleware 或其它 owner 的完整身份保持原属。LoggerErrorCode 有 17 项：

rows: 配置不可读或结构非法；getter 原因保留在 cause
替换 entry.time 不是当前 realm Date，报告并交付原 entry
共享进程退出已开始时仍安装 process
process 身份、配置或时间域不兼容
非成功响应或可重试传输耗尽
retries 不是有限非负整数
flush / shutdown drain 到期仍有工作
安装主错之外还有 listener 回滚错误
插件最终清理失败；可能含未交付 dropped 细节
deadline task 或退出清理失败
failure hook 自身失败，仅走宿主诊断
有界队列满载并丢批，检查 detail.dropped
缺注入 fs 且无当前条件默认能力

blocks.text: failure.source 另一个维度为 defer/hook/sink/pipeline/flush/forward/shutdown，表示失败发生在哪一阶段，不是 semantic source。runtime reporter 自身 throw/rejection 经既有宿主异常队列保持可观察，不递归 Logger reporter，也不替换业务结果。

没有输出先看是否安装 sink，再看 level/filter 与 data.silent；批次逐条发送先确认 batch provider 在同批或已提前安装；关闭后不能复用 Logger；动态插件方法在 handle.extensions。需要确定完成时等待 flush/shutdown，但不要把它当作远端持久化回执。生产组合可选择 level、uuid、batch、http、color、process，配置真实 endpoint，并在宿主关闭边界保留 failure 观察直到 shutdown 完成，而不是为了演示发出网络请求。

symbols.purpose: Table of the stable error codes of this package; values are the strings on `error.code`.
symbols.core:
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: an option is unreadable or invalid; fix it (`cause` keeps the getter error).
pipelineEntryInvalid: `PIPELINE_ENTRY_INVALID`: a stage replaced the entry without a valid `Date`; the original entry is delivered.
runtimeShuttingDown: `RUNTIME_SHUTTING_DOWN`: `process()` or a logger was installed while the process is shutting down.
pluginConfigConflict: `PLUGIN_CONFIG_CONFLICT`: `process()` installed again with a different configuration.
transportUnavailable: `TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE`: `http()` found no `fetch`; inject one in the runtime manager.
serializeFailed: `SERIALIZE_FAILED`: entries could not be turned into JSON; see `cause`.
deliveryFailed: `DELIVERY_FAILED`: upload got a failure response or ran out of retries, or a file write failed.
invalidRetryCount: `INVALID_RETRY_COUNT`: `retries` is not a finite non-negative integer.
lifecycleDeadline: `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE`: flush or shutdown reached its deadline with work left; delivery is not guaranteed.
processInstallRollbackFailed: `PROCESS_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`: `process()` install failed and removing its listeners failed too; read `errors`.
pluginUninstallCleanupFailed: `PLUGIN_UNINSTALL_CLEANUP_FAILED`: some cleanup of an uninstalled plugin failed; read `cause` / `errors`.
pluginShutdownCleanupFailed: `PLUGIN_SHUTDOWN_CLEANUP_FAILED`: cleanup during shutdown or exit failed; the primary error is kept.
hookFailed: `HOOK_FAILED`: an `onFailure` callback itself threw; reported to the console only, never thrown.
extendsSelf: `EXTENDS_SELF`: a logger was forwarded to itself.
extendsCycle: `EXTENDS_CYCLE`: a new `extends()` edge would form a cycle.
batchOverflow: `BATCH_OVERFLOW`: the pending batch limit was reached and the oldest queued batch was dropped.
logPayloadInvalid: LOG_PAYLOAD_INVALID: payload is outside plain JSON data
logStoreLocked: LOG_STORE_LOCKED: another SQLite connection owns the file lock
logStoreInUse: LOG_STORE_IN_USE: another installed plugin borrows the object
logStoreUnavailable: LOG_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: the runtime builtin SQLite is missing
logStoreIoFailed: LOG_STORE_IO_FAILED: storage or cleanup failed; original cause remains reachable
logStoreCorrupt: LOG_STORE_CORRUPT: committed metadata or owned undo data is inconsistent
logSequenceExhausted: LOG_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: a sequence cannot be represented safely
logSubscriptionTruncated: LOG_SUBSCRIPTION_TRUNCATED: prefix truncation passed the subscription cursor
walRecordInvalid: WAL_RECORD_INVALID: a state target is missing or terminal
undoRecordExists: UNDO_RECORD_EXISTS: an active undo transaction id already exists
fileSinkUnavailable: `FILE_SINK_UNAVAILABLE`: `file()` has no injected `fs` and no Node default.

The caller * must fix the option; the native `TypeError` keeps the original accessor failure in `cause` when * one exists. Also rejects shutdown clock failure after admitted plugin cleanup has run.

members.name: pipelineEntryInvalid
members.description: A pipeline supplied a replacement without a current-realm Date time. Dispatch reports this * native TypeError and keeps delivering the original entry; the plugin must preserve its Date.

members.name: runtimeShuttingDown
members.description: Process plugin/logger installation is attempted while runtime shutdown is already in progress. * Enforces terminal shutdown: shutdown admission is terminal for that runtime. The caller must * wait for shutdown to settle or install the logger without the process plugin.

members.name: pluginConfigConflict
members.description: Thrown when the process plugin is installed again with a different configuration. * * Use the same configuration or uninstall the plugin before reinstalling.

members.name: transportUnavailable
members.description: Thrown when the host runtime has no HTTP transport (`fetch`). * * Supply a runtime manager with `fetch` or use the HTTP plugin on a host that supports fetch.

members.name: serializeFailed
members.description: Thrown when serializing HTTP log entries fails. * * `cause` retains the original serialization error. Inspect the logged payload.

members.name: deliveryFailed
members.description: HTTP delivery receives a non-success response or exhausts retryable transport attempts. * Enforces transport delivery reporting; callers must inspect the endpoint/transport and apply * their own delivery remediation while logger failure policy contains the sink failure.

members.name: invalidRetryCount
members.description: HTTP plugin construction receives a retry count that is not a finite non-negative integer. * Enforces plugin configuration admission; callers must correct the plugin configuration before * constructing or installing the logger.

members.name: lifecycleDeadline
members.description: A bounded logger flush or shutdown phase reaches its absolute deadline with work unfinished. * Enforces bounded delivery; callers must treat delivery as degraded and inspect the reported * pending work instead of assuming every entry was delivered.

members.name: processInstallRollbackFailed
members.description: Process plugin installation fails and listener rollback reports one or more additional errors. * Enforces aggregated shutdown reporting; callers must inspect `AggregateError.errors`, fix the * primary installation failure, and verify runtime listeners before retrying installation.

members.name: pluginUninstallCleanupFailed
members.description: Logger plugin final uninstall cleanup attempted every registered action but one or more actions * failed. Enforces cleanup containment; callers must inspect the cause or `AggregateError.errors` * and may create a fresh plugin instance after runtime state resets. A batcher whose final drain * left entries undelivered reports this code with `detail.dropped`.

members.description: Logger shutdown cleanup failed while cancelling a deadline task or invoking the captured exit * path. Enforces cleanup containment; callers must inspect the primary and cleanup errors before * deciding whether the process can continue.

members.name: hookFailed
members.description: Diagnostic code reported when a failure hook throws. It is not thrown itself. * * The reporter uses only `runtime.console.error` or `runtime.write`, preventing recursive failure * reporting.

members.name: extendsSelf

members.name: extendsCycle

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: an option is unreadable or invalid; fix it (`cause` keeps the getter error).
pipelineEntryInvalid: `PIPELINE_ENTRY_INVALID`: a stage replaced the entry without a valid `Date`; the original entry is delivered.
runtimeShuttingDown: `RUNTIME_SHUTTING_DOWN`: `process()` or a logger was installed while the process is shutting down.
pluginConfigConflict: `PLUGIN_CONFIG_CONFLICT`: `process()` installed again with a different configuration.
transportUnavailable: `TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE`: `http()` found no `fetch`; inject one in the runtime manager.
serializeFailed: `SERIALIZE_FAILED`: entries could not be turned into JSON; see `cause`.
deliveryFailed: `DELIVERY_FAILED`: upload got a failure response or ran out of retries, or a file write failed.
invalidRetryCount: `INVALID_RETRY_COUNT`: `retries` is not a finite non-negative integer.
lifecycleDeadline: `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE`: flush or shutdown reached its deadline with work left; delivery is not guaranteed.
processInstallRollbackFailed: `PROCESS_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED`: `process()` install failed and removing its listeners failed too; read `errors`.
pluginUninstallCleanupFailed: `PLUGIN_UNINSTALL_CLEANUP_FAILED`: some cleanup of an uninstalled plugin failed; read `cause` / `errors`.
pluginShutdownCleanupFailed: `PLUGIN_SHUTDOWN_CLEANUP_FAILED`: cleanup during shutdown or exit failed; the primary error is kept.
hookFailed: `HOOK_FAILED`: an `onFailure` callback itself threw; reported to the console only, never thrown.
extendsSelf: `EXTENDS_SELF`: a logger was forwarded to itself.
extendsCycle: `EXTENDS_CYCLE`: a new `extends()` edge would form a cycle.
batchOverflow: `BATCH_OVERFLOW`: the pending batch limit was reached and the oldest queued batch was dropped.
logPayloadInvalid: LOG_PAYLOAD_INVALID: payload is outside plain JSON data
logStoreLocked: LOG_STORE_LOCKED: another SQLite connection owns the file lock
logStoreInUse: LOG_STORE_IN_USE: another installed plugin borrows the object
logStoreUnavailable: LOG_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: the runtime builtin SQLite is missing
logStoreIoFailed: LOG_STORE_IO_FAILED: storage or cleanup failed; original cause remains reachable
logStoreCorrupt: LOG_STORE_CORRUPT: committed metadata or owned undo data is inconsistent
logSequenceExhausted: LOG_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: a sequence cannot be represented safely
logSubscriptionTruncated: LOG_SUBSCRIPTION_TRUNCATED: prefix truncation passed the subscription cursor
walRecordInvalid: WAL_RECORD_INVALID: a state target is missing or terminal
undoRecordExists: UNDO_RECORD_EXISTS: an active undo transaction id already exists
fileSinkUnavailable: `FILE_SINK_UNAVAILABLE`: `file()` has no injected `fs` and no Node default.

blocks.text: Logger 自有错误 source 为 @migaia/logger；来自 Plugin Host、middleware 或其它 owner 的完整身份保持原属。LoggerErrorCode 有 17 项：

rows: 配置不可读或结构非法；getter 原因保留在 cause
替换 entry.time 不是当前 realm Date，报告并交付原 entry
共享进程退出已开始时仍安装 process
process 身份、配置或时间域不兼容
非成功响应或可重试传输耗尽
retries 不是有限非负整数
flush / shutdown drain 到期仍有工作
安装主错之外还有 listener 回滚错误
插件最终清理失败；可能含未交付 dropped 细节
deadline task 或退出清理失败
failure hook 自身失败，仅走宿主诊断
有界队列满载并丢批，检查 detail.dropped
缺注入 fs 且无当前条件默认能力

blocks.text: failure.source 另一个维度为 defer/hook/sink/pipeline/flush/forward/shutdown，表示失败发生在哪一阶段，不是 semantic source。runtime reporter 自身 throw/rejection 经既有宿主异常队列保持可观察，不递归 Logger reporter，也不替换业务结果。

没有输出先看是否安装 sink，再看 level/filter 与 data.silent；批次逐条发送先确认 batch provider 在同批或已提前安装；关闭后不能复用 Logger；动态插件方法在 handle.extensions。需要确定完成时等待 flush/shutdown，但不要把它当作远端持久化回执。生产组合可选择 level、uuid、batch、http、color、process，配置真实 endpoint，并在宿主关闭边界保留 failure 观察直到 shutdown 完成，而不是为了演示发出网络请求。

symbols.signature: export declare const LoggerLevel: { /** Lowest standard threshold, enabled by default in the level plugin. */ readonly debug: 'debug'; /** Ordinary informational level above debug. */ readonly info: 'info'; /** Warning level routed to console.warn by the color plugin. */ readonly warn: 'warn'; /** Error level routed to console.error by the color plugin. */ readonly error: 'error'; /** Highest standard threshold, rendered as fatal without itself exiting the process. */ readonly fatal: 'fatal'; };
symbols.purpose: The five level names used by `level()`, from lowest to highest.
symbols.core:
debug: `debug`: diagnostic details, usually hidden in production.
info: `info`: normal operation events.
warn: `warn`: unexpected but handled situations.
error: `error`: an operation failed.
fatal: `fatal`: the program cannot continue; `process()` logs crashes with it.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples:
import { Logger, LoggerLevel } from '@migaia/logger'
import { level } from '@migaia/logger/plugins'

const log = new Logger({
  execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false },
  plugins: [level({ level: LoggerLevel.warn })]
})
const entries: string[] = []
log.useSink((entry) => {
  entries.push(entry.tag + ':' + entry.message)
})
const off = log.addFilter((entry) => entry.message !== '保密')
log.info('低于阈值')
log.warn('保密')
log.error('可见')
off()
off()
log.warn('保密')
log.setLevel(LoggerLevel.info)
log.info('已放行')
console.log(entries.join(','))
await log.shutdown('manual')

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Plugin adding no logger methods; it provides batching for HTTP and file consumers. Same-batch plugins are sorted by Feature dependencies, independent of array order; a provider installed in a later use call does not retroactively rebind consumers.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import batch from @migaia/logger/plugins, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use batch when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when batch does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
config: Optional default batch settings; see `IBatchPluginConfig`.
A plugin object for one logger.
maxSize: Sends a batch as soon as it holds this many entries.
`20`.
maxWaitMs: Sends a non-empty batch at most this many milliseconds after its first entry arrived.
`2000`.
maxConcurrentBatches: How many batch callbacks may run at once; a positive safe integer.
`1`: batches are delivered one after another, in order.
maxPendingBatches: Limit of queued plus running batches. When full, the oldest queued batch is dropped and `BATCH_OVERFLOW` (with the dropped count) is reported to `onFailure()`.
`1024`.
flushTimeoutMs: Time budget of one batch drain during `flush()` and uninstall; entries still waiting afterwards are reported as not delivered.
`3000`.
asyncOutput: Runs a size-triggered batch callback through `defer()` instead of inside the logging call.
`true`.
After installation `http()` and `file()` installed later send entries in batches; it adds no logger methods. Its `batch` Feature offers `createBatcher()` to custom plugins.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Batchers created through it are drained by `log.flush()` and on shutdown.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxSize
declaredConfiguration.description: Size-triggered batch threshold, defaulting to 20 items.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxWaitMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Delay from the first buffered item to timer-triggered flushing, defaulting to 2000 ms.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxConcurrentBatches
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum number of batches executing at once. Defaults to one for lossless delivery.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxPendingBatches
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum number of queued or executing batches. Defaults to 1024. A full batch beyond it drops the oldest queued batch and reports `BATCH_OVERFLOW` with `detail.dropped`.

declaredConfiguration.name: flushTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Time budget in milliseconds for one `flush()` drain, including the drain on dispose. Defaults to 3000. Entries still buffered or queued when dispose reaches it are dropped and reported.

declaredConfiguration.name: asyncOutput
declaredConfiguration.description: Schedules a full-batch callback asynchronously when enabled. Defaults to `true`; timer-triggered callbacks are already asynchronous.

symbols.signature: export declare const color: (config?: IColorPluginConfig) => ILoggerPlugin<IEmptyPluginExt, IColorPluginConfig, IMiddlewarePipelineMode, { readonly color: typeof loggerColorFeature; }, IColorShared>;
symbols.purpose:
Prints pretty lines or JSON using the captured runtimeManager.console before falling back to write. JSON rendering projects bounded source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors and excludes the local raw Error reference. It adds no logger methods and provides paint/dim to reasoning().

The example supplies required Logger execution.mutationTimeoutMs and execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs as false (no Host deadline), context as the entry path (default []), and plugins (default []). runtimeManager defaults to the current manager; this example borrows its randomUUID, defer and write capabilities, replacing only console.log/warn/error with variadic void callbacks that capture the rendered string.
symbols.core:
config: Optional IColorPluginConfig, defaults to {}.
A plugin object for one logger.
color: Whether ANSI colors are used.
`auto`.
Use never when the output consumer cannot display ANSI sequences, or always when it can but lacks terminal detection. auto, the default, checks NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR, terminal status and CI. Custom colorMap functions still control their own output.
format: Output format of each entry.
Uses LOG_FORMAT only when it is pretty or json; otherwise pretty in CI or a terminal, and json for other output.
One readable line: time, `[LEVEL]`, context, message and arguments.
One JSON object per line, for log collectors.
Use json for a collector and pretty for a person reading the console. Default auto uses LOG_FORMAT when it is pretty or json; otherwise it chooses pretty in a terminal or CI and json elsewhere.
timestamp: Prefix pretty lines with the ISO time.
`true`.
colorMessage: Which part of the message and arguments is colored like the tag.
`none`.
Color the message text.
Color the last argument (or the message when there are no arguments).
Color the message and the last argument.
Color the message and every primitive argument.
Color nothing but the tag.
Choose head to paint the message, tail for the last argument or an argument-free message, head-tail for both, or all for the message and primitive arguments. none, the default, paints only the tag. Objects and errors keep their native values.
colorMap: Paint function per tag, for custom tags such as `audit`; unknown tags stay uncolored.
Built-in colors for the five levels.
Supply a tag-to-function map when custom audit or domain tags need distinctive output. Each function receives text and returns its painted form. Omission retains built-in colors for five standard levels; unmapped custom tags remain unchanged.
After installation every entry is printed to the console (pretty or JSON, colored or not). Entries with `data.silent === true` are skipped. No methods are added; the `color` Feature offers `paint` and `dim`.
symbols.advanced:
Adds a console sink; `error` / `fatal` go to `console.error`, `warn` to `console.warn`.
Lets `reasoning()` color its labels and dim thinking text.
Human-readable development output and JSON lines in containers.

guidance.heading: 通过指定宿主控制台把错误输出为 JSON

blocks.text: 收集器需要可解析 JSON，以及错误名称、消息与堆栈；直接把 `Error` 当普通对象序列化，会丢失不可枚举的内置字段。
直接 `JSON.stringify(new Error())` 通常只得到空对象，手写控制台包装还可能把 JSON 写到另一份宿主控制台，而非当前日志器所使用的那份。
安装 `color({ format: "json" })`，提供公开的 `runtimeManager.console` 接口；本例沿用其余默认能力，仅把控制台输出收集到内存，不写文件也不发送 HTTP。

symbols.name: http
symbols.signature: export declare const http: (config: IHttpPluginConfig) => ILoggerPlugin<IEmptyPluginExt, IHttpPluginConfig, IMiddlewarePipelineMode, { readonly dependencies: typeof httpDependenciesFeature; }>;
symbols.purpose: Sends POST { entries } JSON with retries, timeout and Retry-After. A batch provider installed earlier or in the same dependency-sorted batch enables shared batching. Without it, http.batch creates a bounded local queue forced to maxSize:1 and asyncOutput:false; no batch option uses a direct per-entry sink.
symbols.core:
config: Required; see `IHttpPluginConfig` (`url` is required).
A plugin object; invalid `retries` throw `INVALID_RETRY_COUNT`.
url: Endpoint that receives the `POST { entries }` JSON requests.
authToken: Token issued by the log collector, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Not set: no authorization header.
headers: Extra request headers added to every upload request.
`{}`.
retries: Extra attempts after network errors, 429 and 5xx; other 4xx fail immediately. Waiting uses Retry-After or 200 ms × 2^attempt. Omitted config remains absent; the send path consumes retries ?? 2.
`2`.
requestTimeoutMs: Abort timer for one request when an AbortController is available. This is not an independent Promise race: fetch that ignores its signal may remain pending, and no controller means no request timer. An abort rejection is handled like a network error.
`10000`.
batch: Upload queue settings. An earlier or same-batch Feature provider supplies shared batching regardless of input order. Without a provider, this option still creates a bounded local queue forced to maxSize:1 and asyncOutput:false; other queue bounds apply.
With a shared batch provider: its defaults. Without one: direct per-entry delivery.
batch.maxSize: Sends a batch as soon as it holds this many entries.
`20`.
batch.maxWaitMs: Sends a non-empty batch at most this many milliseconds after its first entry arrived.
`2000`.

blocks.text: Logger 自有错误 source 为 @migaia/logger；来自 Plugin Host、middleware 或其它 owner 的完整身份保持原属。LoggerErrorCode 有 17 项：

rows: 配置不可读或结构非法；getter 原因保留在 cause
替换 entry.time 不是当前 realm Date，报告并交付原 entry
共享进程退出已开始时仍安装 process
process 身份、配置或时间域不兼容
非成功响应或可重试传输耗尽
retries 不是有限非负整数
flush / shutdown drain 到期仍有工作
安装主错之外还有 listener 回滚错误
插件最终清理失败；可能含未交付 dropped 细节
deadline task 或退出清理失败
failure hook 自身失败，仅走宿主诊断
有界队列满载并丢批，检查 detail.dropped
缺注入 fs 且无当前条件默认能力

blocks.text: failure.source 另一个维度为 defer/hook/sink/pipeline/flush/forward/shutdown，表示失败发生在哪一阶段，不是 semantic source。runtime reporter 自身 throw/rejection 经既有宿主异常队列保持可观察，不递归 Logger reporter，也不替换业务结果。

没有输出先看是否安装 sink，再看 level/filter 与 data.silent；批次逐条发送先确认 batch provider 在同批或已提前安装；关闭后不能复用 Logger；动态插件方法在 handle.extensions。需要确定完成时等待 flush/shutdown，但不要把它当作远端持久化回执。生产组合可选择 level、uuid、batch、http、color、process，配置真实 endpoint，并在宿主关闭边界保留 failure 观察直到 shutdown 完成，而不是为了演示发出网络请求。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
color: Whether ANSI colors are used.
`auto`.
Use never when the output consumer cannot display ANSI sequences, or always when it can but lacks terminal detection. auto, the default, checks NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR, terminal status and CI. Custom colorMap functions still control their own output.
format: Output format of each entry.
Uses LOG_FORMAT only when it is pretty or json; otherwise pretty in CI or a terminal, and json for other output.
One readable line: time, `[LEVEL]`, context, message and arguments.
One JSON object per line, for log collectors.
Use json for a collector and pretty for a person reading the console. Default auto uses LOG_FORMAT when it is pretty or json; otherwise it chooses pretty in a terminal or CI and json elsewhere.
timestamp: Prefix pretty lines with the ISO time.
`true`.
colorMessage: Which part of the message and arguments is colored like the tag.
`none`.
Color the message text.
Color the last argument (or the message when there are no arguments).
Color the message and the last argument.
Color the message and every primitive argument.
Color nothing but the tag.
Choose head to paint the message, tail for the last argument or an argument-free message, head-tail for both, or all for the message and primitive arguments. none, the default, paints only the tag. Objects and errors keep their native values.
colorMap: Paint function per tag, for custom tags such as `audit`; unknown tags stay uncolored.
Built-in colors for the five levels.
Supply a tag-to-function map when custom audit or domain tags need distinctive output. Each function receives text and returns its painted form. Omission retains built-in colors for five standard levels; unmapped custom tags remain unchanged.

symbols.name: level
symbols.signature: export declare const level: (config?: ILevelPluginConfig) => ILoggerPlugin<ILevelPluginExt, ILevelPluginConfig>;
symbols.purpose: Adds debug/info/warn/error/fatal methods, a standard-level threshold and filters for every tag. setLevel changes the live threshold; built-in level captures configuration during installation, so config.update alone does not reconfigure that threshold or its filters. The example supplies both required Logger execution budgets as false (no Host deadline), installs this plugin, and registers a memory sink.
symbols.core:
config: Optional ILevelPluginConfig, defaults to {}.
A plugin object for one logger.
level: Minimum standard level; lower standard levels are dropped. Other tags bypass only the threshold and still pass through every filter. Captured at installation; change behavior with setLevel, not config.update alone.
`debug`: all five standard levels meet the threshold.
Use warn for a production service and debug while diagnosing it. The ordered thresholds are debug, info, warn, error and fatal; each keeps that level and higher standard levels. Omission selects debug. Custom tags still pass through filters.
filters: Filters `(entry) => boolean`; an entry passes only if all return `true`.
`[]`: no filters.
asyncOutput: Schedule entries created by `info()` and the other level methods with `defer()`.
`false`: output during the call.
Installs severity-based logging. debug(), info(), warn(), error() and fatal() create entries with the corresponding level. setLevel() changes the minimum level; addFilter() and removeFilter() register and remove output filters. Without this plugin, use the core log() method. Entries from debug(), info(), warn(), error() and fatal() reach output only when their level meets the configured minimum and every installed filter accepts them. Entries below the minimum or rejected by any filter are discarded. For all five methods, a string first argument becomes the message, while remaining arguments are kept for output. For example, info("Order %s", orderId) keeps the placeholder and orderId for the output handler. If the first argument is not a string, the message is empty and every argument is retained in the args array.
symbols.advanced: Level-based logging with runtime level changes.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples:
import { Logger, LoggerLevel } from '@migaia/logger'
import { level } from '@migaia/logger/plugins'

const log = new Logger({
  execution: { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false },
  plugins: [level({ level: LoggerLevel.warn })]
})
const entries: string[] = []
log.useSink((entry) => {
  entries.push(entry.tag + ':' + entry.message)
})
const off = log.addFilter((entry) => entry.message !== '保密')
log.info('低于阈值')
log.warn('保密')
log.error('可见')
off()
off()
log.warn('保密')
log.setLevel(LoggerLevel.info)
log.info('已放行')
console.log(entries.join(','))
await log.shutdown('manual')

blocks.text: Logger 自有错误 source 为 @migaia/logger；来自 Plugin Host、middleware 或其它 owner 的完整身份保持原属。LoggerErrorCode 有 17 项：

rows: 配置不可读或结构非法；getter 原因保留在 cause
替换 entry.time 不是当前 realm Date，报告并交付原 entry
共享进程退出已开始时仍安装 process
process 身份、配置或时间域不兼容
非成功响应或可重试传输耗尽
retries 不是有限非负整数
flush / shutdown drain 到期仍有工作
安装主错之外还有 listener 回滚错误
插件最终清理失败；可能含未交付 dropped 细节
deadline task 或退出清理失败
failure hook 自身失败，仅走宿主诊断
有界队列满载并丢批，检查 detail.dropped
缺注入 fs 且无当前条件默认能力

blocks.text: failure.source 另一个维度为 defer/hook/sink/pipeline/flush/forward/shutdown，表示失败发生在哪一阶段，不是 semantic source。runtime reporter 自身 throw/rejection 经既有宿主异常队列保持可观察，不递归 Logger reporter，也不替换业务结果。

没有输出先看是否安装 sink，再看 level/filter 与 data.silent；批次逐条发送先确认 batch provider 在同批或已提前安装；关闭后不能复用 Logger；动态插件方法在 handle.extensions。需要确定完成时等待 flush/shutdown，但不要把它当作远端持久化回执。生产组合可选择 level、uuid、batch、http、color、process，配置真实 endpoint，并在宿主关闭边界保留 failure 观察直到 shutdown 完成，而不是为了演示发出网络请求。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
config: Optional; see `IProcessPluginConfig`.
A plugin object for one logger.
captureCrashes: Controls only fatal logging for uncaughtException/unhandledRejection. Both crash events still trigger shutdown and exit(1) when false; beforeExit only flushes.
`true`.
shutdownTimeoutMs: Longest drain on signal, crash or exit before the process exits anyway.
`3000`.
interceptProcessExit: Make `process.exit()` flush first; this turns an immediate exit into an asynchronous one.
`false`.
Connects process events to Logger cleanup without adding logger methods. SIGINT and SIGTERM start shutdown and wait up to shutdownTimeoutMs before requesting exit. Uncaught exceptions and unhandled Promise rejections use exit code 1 even when captureCrashes is false; that option only controls whether a fatal entry is logged first. beforeExit, emitted when the event loop is about to become idle, flushes accepted logs without starting shutdown.

symbols.name: ILogStore
symbols.signature: export type ILogStore = { append<const T extends readonly ILogRecordInput[]>(records: T & ILogBatchInput<T>): Promise<readonly number[]>; read(fromSeq: number, limit: number): Promise<readonly ILogRecord[]>; lastSeq(): Promise<number>; onAppend(listener: (notice: ILogAppendNotice) => void): () => void; truncate(beforeSeq: number): Promise<void>; setState(seq: number, state: LogRecordState): Promise<void>; states(filter: typeof LogRecordState.pending): Promise<readonly number[]>; dispose(): Promise<void>; [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>; };
symbols.purpose: Durable logger contract with explicit ownership and initialization.
symbols.core:
append: Atomically commit a batch and create pending states; empty batches allocate no sequences. Inputs are captured immediately.
read: Read ascending retained snapshots from an inclusive sequence and an explicit nonnegative limit.
lastSeq: Read the committed high watermark, preserved after complete truncation.
onAppend: Observe one frozen {lastSeq,count} notice per nonempty real commit; return an idempotent cancellation function.
truncate: Delete only seq < beforeSeq without reusing committed sequences.
setState: Only pending may advance to done or aborted; terminal and missing records reject WAL_RECORD_INVALID.
states: Return pending sequence numbers in creation order, excluding terminal history.
dispose: Close admission, drain accepted work, and return one cached explicit cleanup Promise; failure rejects.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Share the same cleanup using a separate cached Promise that reports failure and resolves.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.
examples:
import { memoryLogStore } from '@migaia/logger/plugins/durable'
import type { ILogStore } from '@migaia/logger/plugins/durable'

const delegate = memoryLogStore()
// A custom implementation must preserve this single owner's atomic commit and notices.
const custom: ILogStore = {
  append: (records) => delegate.append(records),
  read: (fromSeq, limit) => delegate.read(fromSeq, limit),
  lastSeq: () => delegate.lastSeq(),
  onAppend: (listener) => delegate.onAppend(listener),
  truncate: (beforeSeq) => delegate.truncate(beforeSeq),
  setState: (seq, state) => delegate.setState(seq, state),
  states: (filter) => delegate.states(filter),
  dispose: () => delegate.dispose(),
  [Symbol.asyncDispose]: () => delegate[Symbol.asyncDispose]()
}
await custom.append([{ kind: 'custom', payload: null }])

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
append: Atomically commit a batch and create pending states; empty batches allocate no sequences. Inputs are captured immediately.
read: Read ascending retained snapshots from an inclusive sequence and an explicit nonnegative limit.
lastSeq: Read the committed high watermark, preserved after complete truncation.
onAppend: Observe one frozen {lastSeq,count} notice per nonempty real commit; return an idempotent cancellation function.
truncate: Delete only seq < beforeSeq without reusing committed sequences.
setState: Only pending may advance to done or aborted; terminal and missing records reject WAL_RECORD_INVALID.
states: Return pending sequence numbers in creation order, excluding terminal history.
dispose: Close admission, drain accepted work, and return one cached explicit cleanup Promise; failure rejects.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Share the same cleanup using a separate cached Promise that reports failure and resolves.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Plugin that appends entries to a file as JSON lines, one batch per append, and can ask the injected `fs` to rotate the file. Write failures go to `onFailure()`.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import file from @migaia/logger/plugins/file, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
config: Required; see `IFilePluginConfig` (`path` is required).
A plugin object; an empty `path` or invalid `rotate` limits throw `INVALID_OPTION`.
path: File the JSON lines are appended to; must not be empty.
batch: Batch settings; with `batch()` installed they are applied over its defaults.
Not set: the batch defaults (20 entries or 2 seconds).
batch.maxSize: Sends a batch as soon as it holds this many entries.
`20`.
batch.maxWaitMs: Sends a non-empty batch at most this many milliseconds after its first entry arrived.
`2000`.
batch.maxConcurrentBatches: How many batch callbacks may run at once; a positive safe integer.
`1`: batches are delivered one after another, in order.
batch.maxPendingBatches: Limit of queued plus running batches. When full, the oldest queued batch is dropped and `BATCH_OVERFLOW` (with the dropped count) is reported to `onFailure()`.
`1024`.
batch.flushTimeoutMs: Time budget of one batch drain during `flush()` and uninstall; entries still waiting afterwards are reported as not delivered.
`3000`.
batch.asyncOutput: Runs a size-triggered batch callback through `defer()` instead of inside the logging call.
`true`.
rotate: After appending a batch that reached a limit, call `runtimeManager.fs.rotate(path)`. The Node default `fs` has no `rotate`, so rotation needs an injected `fs`.
Not set: never rotate.
rotate.maxBytes: Rotate when one batch is at least this many UTF-8 bytes; a positive safe integer.
Not set: no byte limit.
rotate.maxEntries: Rotate when one batch holds at least this many entries; a positive safe integer.
Not set: no entry limit.
After installation every entry is appended to `path` as one JSON line, batch by batch, through `runtimeManager.fs` or the Node default. No methods are added; write failures reach `onFailure()` as `DELIVERY_FAILED`.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Installing without any `fs` capability fails; the install error carries `FILE_SINK_UNAVAILABLE` on `cause`.
Remaining entries are written on `flush()` and when the logger shuts down.
Keep local JSON-lines logs on a server or desktop app.

declaredConfiguration.description: Delay from the first buffered item to timer-triggered flushing, defaulting to 2000 ms.

declaredConfiguration.name: batch.maxConcurrentBatches
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum number of batches executing at once. Defaults to one for lossless delivery.

declaredConfiguration.name: batch.maxPendingBatches
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum number of queued or executing batches. Defaults to 1024. A full batch beyond it drops the oldest queued batch and reports `BATCH_OVERFLOW` with `detail.dropped`.

declaredConfiguration.name: batch.flushTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Time budget in milliseconds for one `flush()` drain, including the drain on dispose. Defaults to 3000. Entries still buffered or queued when dispose reaches it are dropped and reported.

declaredConfiguration.name: batch.asyncOutput
declaredConfiguration.description: Schedules a full-batch callback asynchronously when enabled. Defaults to `true`; timer-triggered callbacks are already asynchronous.
